description: All four runs of the predeclared large-dataset snapshot pilot, before buffered snapshot output: frozen d2d5eb8 Engine with fixed 7d29382 Gateway and Benchmark; 20000 then 100000 keys, snapshot off then 5000ms on, one run per condition, 1500000 measured requests and 1024-byte values. Retains the complete parent plan, two host-before records and both stage artifacts. Only actual binary copies and generated data are omitted. Every run satisfied the declared duration and internal snapshot-completion coverage. A single OFF/ON pair per dataset does not establish causal snapshot cost or the performance of subsequent buffer changes.
